svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: AI, machine learning, and deep learning are nested
svg.desc: Nested ovals. The outer oval is Artificial Intelligence: computers behaving like humans in some respect. Inside it is Machine Learning: math that finds connections in data. Inside that is Deep Learning: machine learning that sets its own parameters. Innermost are LLMs, the models behind AI assistants.
svg.text: computers behaving like humans in some respect
math that finds connections in data
ML that sets its own parameters
